description: This file implements input conversion functions for a build system, including parsing JSON, lists, and scope from strings, and handling input/output conversion options with detailed documentation.

methods.name: ParseValueOrScope
methods.description: Parses a string input as either a value expression or a scope, returning a Value object.

methods.name: ParseList
methods.description: Parses a string into a list of lines, trimming whitespace and handling empty lines.

methods.name: IsIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a string view is a valid identifier according to tokenizer rules.

methods.name: ParseJSONValue
methods.description: Recursively converts a base::Value (parsed from JSON) into a GN Value, handling different data types.

methods.name: ParseJSON
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a GN Value, using the JSONReader and converting the result.

methods.name: DoConvertInputToValue
methods.description: Handles conversion of input strings based on specified conversion options, including recursive handling of 'trim' prefix and different conversion modes.

methods.name: ConvertInputToValue
methods.description: Public API that converts an input string to a GN Value based on input conversion settings.
